verdict.summary: The round-4 diff remains correct and complete. The empty-frontier observation is derived fail-closed from a successful claim and a complete, type-valid raw summary; the shell dispatcher pins the exact recording commands; `idle` is restricted to the fleet pseudo-provider; and its CAS-side suppression applies only when the newest in-window fleet record is already idle. Classification treats idle as a true boundary, closing an existing zero-dispatch alert immediately without allowing pre-idle failures to contribute to re-entry, while keeping idle out of success-based health evidence. Coverage exercises malformed and incomplete summaries, the producer/workflow seams, boundary and re-arm behavior, same-timestamp ordering, expiry and future skew, provider isolation, write-gate narrowness, and delivery into the real alert-closing path. No reviewer-directed instruction or other prompt-injection text was detected in the diff.
